baseline_preflight.impact: Capacity analysis remains reproducible from the verified immutable Track02 ISO; release build preflight remains blocked until the archived evidence file is restored or Task 0 is revised.

translation_audit.build_input_note: Task 6 consumes all non-empty translations for capacity planning. Rows still marked needs_review are not release-build eligible.

assumptions.string_policy: deduplicate exact translated strings per module; projected encoder bytes plus one NUL; no string crosses an 8-KiB bank
assumptions.capacity_policy: conservative whole-bank capacity inside each 96-sector loader window
assumptions.source_hole_policy: source_hole_bytes are a structural reclaim estimate from the prior redirect audit; any module that needs them remains an explicit Task 8 materialization branch
assumptions.packed_warning: 18-byte fit is an estimate only; Task 5 proves only the 32-byte expanded path

font.family_role: sole Hangul source for all builds created after this policy

core_glyph_replication.reason: Task 5 validates module-lifetime data; a global resident pool requires unproven RAM lifetime and exceeds the global custom-code space.
